Welcome! This issue tracks your progress through the AI-Native Workforce Workflow exercise. A bot will check your work at each step and post the next step's instructions here as a comment — no need to look anywhere else once you get started.

> [!TIP]
> Stuck, or want to redo a step? For Step 1, just edit this issue body — the bot re-checks automatically. For later steps, post a new comment and it will be re-checked.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This exercise is about building a **reusable workforce**, not just shipping one feature. Each step adds a durable, reusable asset to this repo (context files, an agent, a workflow) that you'll reuse again in Step 8 — and could reuse on real work after that.

## Step 1: Baseline today's friction

Replace this section with 3-4 things that currently slow you down when shipping a feature in **this repo** — be specific to this codebase, not generic ("coding is slow" doesn't count). For example: re-explaining component conventions every time, writing tests by hand, or having no single place to check what's highest priority.
